title: Kami: a Claude Code skill that enforces one design language across every document it generates
description:
AI-generated documents all look the same, generic corporate gray or SaaS gradient soup. Kami is a Claude Code skill that enforces a single design language across every format. Warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif for authority, sans for utility. Ask for a white paper, resume, pitch deck, or portfolio and it auto-triggers. Six document types, three SVG diagram primitives, eight design invariants that never break.

https://github.com/tw93/Kami
